summary: Governed personal world model and memory for your AI agent. Pair once, connect over MCP.

toolsPreview.name: odei_connect_handshake
toolsPreview.description: Verify an app.odei.ai pairing code and open an ODEI Connect session.

toolsPreview.name: odei_connect_status
toolsPreview.description: Return current ODEI Connect ceremony progress.

toolsPreview.name: odei_connect_plan
toolsPreview.description: Return the ordered local ODEI install plan and reporting contract.

toolsPreview.name: odei_connect_report_step
toolsPreview.description: Record evidence that a Connect ceremony step has completed.

toolsPreview.name: odei_connect_talk
toolsPreview.description: Answer from ODEI Connect session state without invoking a model API.

toolsPreview.name: wm_remember
toolsPreview.description: Write one fact to your operator memory in ODEI — the World Model grows from it. Server-side (ODEI-hosted) memory for the paired operator; not the local world-model capsule.

toolsPreview.name: wm_recall
toolsPreview.description: Read facts back from your ODEI-hosted operator memory. Simple substring + recency match (v1) — no semantic search yet.
